sentences.text: 1 went to the shop of applicant Babbu Sarpanch to purchase some eating article for Rs.5/-.
When she was about to leave the shop, applicant Babbu Sarpanch called her, caught hold her left hand and took her inside the flour room.
He gagged her mouth, touched her body parts, took out her leggi and twice committed rape upon her.
He threatened her to do death if she discloses the incident to anyone.
She did not narrate the incident to anyone for two days.
After two days she narrated the incident to her mother.
F.I.R was registered.
After investigation charge sheet was filed.
Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant has not committed any offence.
He is innocent.
He has been falsely implicated due to political rivalry of the village.
F.I.R has been lodged after two days of the alleged incident.
F.S.L. and medical report of the prosecutrix are negative.
Trial of the case will take considerable time.
Therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant may be released on bail.
On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed the grant of bail to the applicant.
In this case after investigation charge sheet has been filed.
In medical examination no injury has been found around prosecutrix's genital region or any part of the body.
Vaginal swab slide including undergarments were sent for forensic examination but FSL report is negative.

Thus having taken into consideration the argument of learned counsel for the applicant and the material on record, I am of the view that it is a case in which further pre-trial detention of the present applicant/accused is not warranted.

Therefore, without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this first bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

It is directed that applicant-Babbu @ Babu Singh Lodhi be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees F ifty thousand o nly) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the concerned Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this behalf by the trial Court during the pendency of trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
